items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: Johnson, Al Casey, John Kirby and you.

ctx.x: And Edmund Hall, Pete Brown and Cecil Scott, Don Frye, John Smith on guitar, Dick Fulbright--we talked about him earlier--you and Clarence Palmer the vocalist. And those were the ones for March 5th, 1937, and you did some ones on April 15th, a month later with Russell Procope and Slim Gaillard. Otherwise it was the same band. In 1939 it was Frankie, Mezz Mezzrow ... Pete Brown, James P.
Johnson, Al Casey, John Kirby and you. Do you remember those sessions at all?
Yeah, yeah, but I'm trying to remember as you were reading them down, you know.
